read_csv_ava_format: create a function that reads an AVA format CSV file and returns boxes, labels, and scores dictionaries
read_exclusions_timestamps: create a function that reads a CSV of excluded video timestamps and returns a set of excluded image keys
read_labelmap_class_ids: create a function that reads a label map file and returns category labels and class IDs
evaluate_ava_predictions: run AVA evaluation on prediction arrays and ground truth data to compute mAP metrics
write_results_ava_csv: write detection results as boxes, labels, and scores into an official AVA CSV file format
